top_signals.title: Rheinmetall shares plunge 17% after outlook cut as military contracts stall
top_signals.summary: Rheinmetall cut its 2026 outlook for the second time in three months, citing delays to German military projects and artillery ammunition deliveries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Renee Montgomery’s Move From Player to Owner
top_signals.summary:
In this episode of The Deal, Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly talk with the Atlanta Dream’s Renee Montgomery about why she decided to retire from the WNBA to co-own the team.
		
		
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Odd Lots: What Comes Next After Lula’s Big Win (Podcast)
top_signals.summary: When we last talked to James Bosworth, it seemed like an “orange wave” was going to take over Latin America and further realign the region’s interests with those of the Trump administration. But with Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s surprise victory in Brazil’s presidential election last month, and opposition leader María Corina Machado’s return to Venezuela, it now looks like the orange wave might be cresting.
